title: Efficient Quantum Circuit Construction of Controlled Time-Evolution for Arbitrary Pauli-Sum Hamiltonians
summary: Controlled time-evolution circuits select forward or backward Hamiltonian time evolution according to the state of an ancilla qubit. They are fundamental building blocks in quantum eigenvalue transformation of unitaries, Hamiltonian filtering, and related quantum algorithms. A direct realization adds ancilla control to the elementary gates of the time-evolution circuit and therefore increases the two-qubit gate count, compiled T depth and CX depth.
